name: realistic-fusion-refreshed-assets
title: Realistic Fusion Refreshed Assets
author: Truls Johnsen
description:
Every sprite Realistic Fusion Refreshed and Realistic Fusion Refreshed Core draw, in one mod so that updating either of them does not re-download the art. It adds no prototype, no recipe and no technology, and installing it on its own changes nothing in the game; the two mods that use it each require it.

The art is Krastorio 2's, taken from its own asset repository rather than from any predecessor mod, and licensed under LGPLv3 -- see legal-note.txt beside this file, and graphics/krastorio-2/NOTICE.txt, which records every file taken, what it was renamed to and what was changed about it. The placeholder building sprites in graphics/mockup/ are this repository's own work and carry its licence.

Credit for the original design goes to Romner_set, for the 2.0 port to Durikkan, and for graphics work to PreLeyZero; none of their licences asks for it.
